description: This file provides functions to parse shell command strings into sub-commands, handling complex shell syntax including quotes, subshells, redirections, and operators, using the 'shell-quote' library.

methods.name: parseCommand
methods.description: Splits a shell command string into individual sub-commands, handling multi-line commands and preserving quoted strings.

methods.name: parseCommandLine
methods.description: Parses a single line of shell commands into sub-commands, handling complex syntax elements.
